source.version: Undated saved manuscript; the document prints no date or version number and calls C2 the corrected convergent-stage condition (PDF p. 23). The supplied citation record identifies this file as PsyArXiv version 1, DOI 10.31234/osf.io/5tfng_v1, posted 2026-06-17; that date/version is citation metadata rather than printed PDF text.
source.supplement_used: Supplementary Information embedded in the same PDF, PDF pp. 19-70 (printed SI pp. 1-52), including S1 supplementary methods, supplementary tables and figure captions. No external supplement, posted dataset or scoring code was used.

studies.label: Phase-contingent AI access in three-person teams (product-idea task)
studies.cluster_se_treatment: Main planned comparisons and timing regressions analyze one aggregated score per randomized team. Timing regressions use team-level HC3 robust SEs and task fixed effects, so the team clustering is handled by aggregation. Bootstrap resampling units and mixed-model random effects are not specified; their robustness records are marked unclear.

arms.name: C1 Divergent AI
arms.description: AI assistant during divergent search only. Access windows: PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4. Analyzed counts: PDF p. 27 (printed SI p. 9), Supplementary Table 1.

arms.name: C2 Convergent AI
arms.description: AI assistant during convergent selection only; the manuscript calls this the corrected convergent-stage condition. Access windows: PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4. Analyzed counts: PDF p. 27 (printed SI p. 9), Supplementary Table 1.

arms.name: C3 Full-process AI
arms.description: AI assistant during all task stages. Access windows: PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4. Analyzed counts: PDF p. 27 (printed SI p. 9), Supplementary Table 1.

arms.name: C4 No AI
arms.description: No LLM interface at any time. Access windows: PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4. Analyzed counts: PDF p. 27 (printed SI p. 9), Supplementary Table 1.

arms.name: C5 Divergent AI + warning
arms.description: Divergent-stage access plus a persistent, non-dismissible warning that AI is an initial reference and teams should discuss its ideas critically. Access windows: PDF p. 23 (printed SI p. 5), S1.4. Analyzed counts: PDF p. 27 (printed SI p. 9), Supplementary Table 1.

studies.task: Teams designed a written product or service concept combining a backpack with a pet accessory, a refrigerator with a calendar, or shoes with a map, using divergent search, convergent selection and final consolidation in the same task.

ai_tool.name: DeepSeek V3.2 via the integrated LLM query interface and API
